P8287.notes: Source is the May 1999 notice of application and the April 2000 notice of the environmental assessment. Sum of the three is 44.26 mi, matching 44.3. The Georgia loop is 24-inch and is on the North Georgia Extension, whose mileposts restart at 0.00, so it cannot be cut from the mainline geometry; it needs the extension route. The Alabama counties in the sources are Choctaw, Marengo, Perry and Dallas, not Coosa and Chilton as the task assumed; Coosa (Station 105) and Chilton (Station 100) only have compressor work. Henry County (Station 120) and Coweta (Station 115) are compressor work too. The 42-inch loop does not start at a station and ends at Station 90 (pig launcher at MP 764.66 upstream). No coordinates found.

P8283.notes: Five 42-inch loops, about 22.6 mi combined, in Coosa and Randolph Counties, Alabama and Gaston, Rowan and Davidson Counties, North Carolina (notice of application and notice of environmental assessment). No loop names, individual lengths, mileposts or coordinates were found; the Federal Register notices do not give them. Phase 1 per a trade report included three loops in Randolph County AL and Gaston and Davidson Counties NC. Needs the FERC order or EA for docket CP11-18 from eLibrary. Compressor Stations 105 (Coosa), 140 (Spartanburg SC) and 145 (Cleveland NC) are modification sites only.

P8285.notes: Loops listed are the Momentum loops as amended in February 2003 (Phase I in service May 2003, Phase II May 2004). Phase I sum of Magnolia, Jones, Kellyton I and Bowman is 43.14 mi, not 42.26, so one length differs from the GEM figure (as-built or a different phase split); the project record should be checked. Phase II adds Kellyton II 6.84 mi. The Hale Loop (MP 767.38 to 772.80, Clarke County MS) was eliminated. The July 2001 application also had Seminary (MP 732.65-740.55, Jones Co MS), Richville (MP 905.74-909.23, Chilton Co AL) and Greenville (MP 1201.71-1205.89, Spartanburg Co SC) loops, eliminated in the September 2001 amendment. Bowman end MP is 1,132.25 in the application and 1132.23 in the amendment. The task description (Louisiana to North Carolina) does not match: the loops run Mississippi to Georgia. No lines other than 'mainline' stated, no coordinates found. Magnolia end county Pike in the original 6.63 mi version.
